name: youpji-admin
description: 游迹 AI 旅游平台 V0.1 — Admin 管理后台

scripts.dev: node -e 'const http = require("http"), fs = require("fs"), path = require("path"); http.createServer((req, res) => { let p = path.join("dist", req.url === "/" ? "index.html" : req.url); if (!fs.existsSync(p)) p = path.join("dist", "index.html"); const ext = path.extname(p); const ct = ext === ".css" ? "text/css" : ext === ".js" ? "application/javascript" : "text/html"; res.writeHead(200, { "Content-Type": ct }); fs.createReadStream(p).pipe(res); }).listen(8088, () => console.log("Admin dev server running at http://localhost:8088"));'
